entries.name: Clinique Vétérinaire Bereldange (Walferdange)
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8:00-20:00, Sat 8:00-17:00; emergency service 24/7. After hours and weekends call first: emergency partner EVC Luxembourg +352 27 83 93 00 (same building)

duty_i18n.sl: pon–pet 8–20, sob 8–17; nujna pomoč 24 ur na dan. Zunaj delovnega časa in ob vikendih najprej pokličite: partner za nujne primere EVC Luxembourg +352 27 83 93 00 (v isti stavbi)
duty_i18n.hr: pon–pet 8:00–20:00, sub 8:00–17:00; hitna služba 24/7. Izvan radnog vremena i vikendom nazovi unaprijed: hitni partner EVC Luxembourg +352 27 83 93 00 (u istoj zgradi).
duty_i18n.de: Mo–Fr 8–20 Uhr, Sa 8–17 Uhr; Notdienst rund um die Uhr. Außerhalb der Sprechzeiten und am Wochenende bitte zuerst anrufen: Notdienstpartner EVC Luxembourg +352 27 83 93 00 (im selben Gebäude)
duty_i18n.fr: Lun.–ven. 8 h–20 h, sam. 8 h–17 h ; urgences 24 h/24, 7 j/7. En dehors de ces horaires et le week-end, appelez d’abord : partenaire d’urgence EVC Luxembourg +352 27 83 93 00 (même bâtiment)

entries.note: vet.lu/urgences and /contact opened. Clinic is branded 'Bereldange' but its page address is Walferdange (14 Millewee); older directories list 29 am Becheler, Bereldange.
entries.quote: Notre service d'urgence est ouvert 24h/24 et 7j/7

entries.name: Collège Vétérinaire - gardes / urgences (duty rota)
entries.duty: Official page of the veterinary chamber listing the vets on call, split by small animals, livestock and equines. The phone is the chamber's office, not an emergency line

duty_i18n.sl: Uradna stran veterinarske zbornice s seznamom dežurnih veterinarjev za male živali, kmetijske živali in konje. Telefon je številka pisarne zbornice, ne številka za nujne primere
duty_i18n.hr: Službena stranica veterinarske komore s popisom dežurnih veterinara, podijeljenim na male životinje, stoku i konje. Telefon je ured komore, a ne hitna linija.
duty_i18n.de: Offizielle Seite der Tierärztekammer mit den diensthabenden Tierärzten, gegliedert nach Kleintieren, Nutztieren und Pferden. Die Telefonnummer ist die des Kammerbüros, keine Notrufnummer
duty_i18n.fr: Page officielle du Collège vétérinaire listant les vétérinaires de garde, par petits animaux, animaux de rente et équidés. Le numéro est celui du secrétariat du Collège, pas une ligne d’urgence

entries.note: Page opened. It listed two on-call vets with mobile numbers dated July 2025 (stale; individuals' numbers deliberately not copied). Rota is dynamic; /fr/gardes could not be fetched. Garde obligation for every established vet is stated on the page.

notes: No animal poison line included: the SOSVET poisoning page lists CNITV +33 4 78 87 10 40, CAPAE-Ouest +33 2 40 68 77 40 and the Belgian Centre Antipoisons +32 70 245 245 in a dog-poisoning context but does not say which serve animals, so none was added. Left/unreachable: Cabinet Vétérinaire du Cèdre (veterinaires.lu redirects http<->https in a loop, only secondary data seen), Dudelange branch of vet.lu (+352 51 38 15, 47 rue de Hellange; vet.lu/contact lists only Walferdange, only aggregator data), yourvets.lu (robots disallow; says Krakelshaff and Bereldange are the 24/7 small-animal hospitals), Collège /fr/gardes (fetch failed), collegeveterinaire.lu dynamic vet search (312 vets, not readable), lak.lu duty page (not opened), Differdange/Ettelbruck/Diekirch/Echternach/Wiltz/Clervaux/Remich practices (only editus.lu/yellow.lu directory listings found, no own sites reachable: e.g. Dr Mendels Ettelbruck, Ihry Pit Diekirch, Drs Paris/Voisin Wiltz, MäiVet Lipperscheid), Alzingen (Déiereklinik Alzeng / LuxiVet), Mondorf/Remich, Luxembourg-city equine practices, PetGarage-style chains. Only the two clinics and SOSVET state 24 h; the rota covers nights via Bereldange and Krakelshaff per the Foyer insurer blog (not an official source, not opened as basis for any entry).
